answer: Correlation penalties: when many accounts answer in near-identical rhythm, share funding sources, or attest each other in a closed loop, the ledger treats the cluster as one actor and splits a single reward among them. A sybil farm hoping for a haven of easy payouts finds its velvet disguise worthless; each fake identity still costs registration work, yet the cluster earns no more than one honest agent. Identity becomes marble-heavy to fake and cheap to verify.
